Application Data.NAME: Heritage Library and Museum
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Heritage Library and Museum specializes in the preservation and exhibition of historical artifacts and literature. Our operations include providing access to a vast collection of rare documents, manuscripts, and art pieces, which are maintained under strict environmental controls and fire suppression systems. We host educational programs and guided tours for the public, with a focus on engaging the community in history and culture. Our events feature refreshments, but no alcohol is served, and we employ a part-time security guard to ensure the safety of our collections. We also utilize an online ticketing system for event admissions, reflecting our commitment to modern technology and customer convenience while addressing potential cyber risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/12/2023, a pipe burst in the basement storage area causing water damage to a collection of historical documents. The estimated loss amount was $3,500, and the issue has been resolved with professional restoration services completed by 04/15/2023.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Employs part-time security personnel and has fencing around valuable artifact display areas.
